title: The Helmet by the Pond
pages: Your fingers close on a dented helmet half-sunk in the reeds, and the world goes quiet.
You see two boys at this same pond a long time ago. One of them is laughing in a way that does not quite reach his eyes. He is showing the other how to wear it.
'When I am the hero,' he says, 'I'll come back and tell you exactly how it really happened.'
The other boy is the Old Soldier. He is much younger. He is not laughing.
The vision releases you. The helmet is just a helmet again. But the pond no longer feels so quiet.
